title: Carbon-X is an open 14.8B model trained jointly on DNA and text [R]
summary: Carbon-X is a 14.8B parameter decoder-only model that takes raw DNA in a normal chat and answers in English. It shares one token stream for text and DNA, using 6-mer tokens, and was mid-trained on 302B tokens. Hugging Face reports a 66.7% average across five DNA benchmarks with t
